title: Synthetic release-readiness evidence exercise
scope: Fixture-only assessment of package, documentation, status, archive, artifact, and deployment evidence.
exclusions: Do not infer that these fixture findings describe the actual repository.

package: The built package artifact matches current package metadata.
publication: The available evidence supports publication readiness.

execution_lanes.scope: Compare current package metadata, built artifact versions, and reproducibility evidence.
execution_lanes.evidence_contract: Versioned package metadata and independently acquired build manifest with hashes.
execution_lanes.completion_gate: All artifact versions match metadata and repeat builds have verified identical digests.

execution_lanes.scope: Compare live documentation and active status narratives to current source and release evidence.
execution_lanes.evidence_contract: Timestamped source files and inspected live documentation with browser diagnostics.
execution_lanes.completion_gate: Docs and active status agree with package truth and validation evidence.

execution_lanes.scope: Assess archive role, deployment evidence, contradictions, and publication gate after P1 and P2.
execution_lanes.evidence_contract: Linked evidence and unresolved-issue matrix from upstream lanes.
execution_lanes.completion_gate: Publication recommendation is supported by all applicable objectives and no unresolved blockers.

objectives.question: Do current package metadata and built artifact versions match?
Does the live documentation site match the source package version?
Does the active status narrative reflect current validation evidence?
Does historical archive evidence establish the current release state?
What publication readiness decision is supported by the evidence?
